title_en: Psychology Made Simple (9/20): I Understand How You Feel
note_en: 小陈站在小玉的角度 uses the set frame 站在…的角度, literally "stand at someone's angle," to mean seeing things from another person's point of view. English has its own image for this, "put yourself in someone's shoes," so translate the idea, not the words; the same frame works with any noun: 站在老板的角度 "from the boss's point of view."
